transport: localhost multiprocessing connection with process-local authentication; not TLS and not multi-device
masking: pairwise HKDF-SHA256 pseudorandom masks with opposite signs
limitations: All clients ran as independent processes on one physical machine, not on real remote devices.
Dropout recovery, malicious-client robustness, and transport TLS are not implemented.
The coordinator sees client identity, sample count, and masked update shape.
Secure aggregation hides individual plaintext updates from this coordinator but does not provide differential privacy for the aggregate model.
